settings.text: I’m a cell biologist and a former cricketer. I built MUTO because I was tired of supplements that ask you to take them on trust.
So every ingredient and every dose is on the label, with the reason it’s there. Got a question about the formula? Ask me.
And don’t take my word for it. Note your starting point, give it 90 days, and make your own call.
I’m not done yet either. Most people who take MUTO are in their 40s and 50s, still training, still working.

settings.title: Will it work for me?
settings.text: We won’t promise what it’ll do for you. Note your starting point, give it 90 days, and judge it yourself. If you don’t see a difference, you’re covered.

settings.title: What’s actually in it?
settings.text: 19 ingredients, every dose on the label: 300mg NR (the most allowed in Great Britain), a full B complex, vitamin D3 and K2, zinc, copper, CoQ10 and more. Ask your AI, your GP, or Richie, who answers formula questions himself.

settings.title: Is it worth the money?
settings.text: Compare it with your cupboard, not with zero. MUTO is about £2 a day, in one routine instead of several separate pots, and you have 90 days to decide.

settings.title: Am I locked into a subscription?
settings.text: No. Skip, pause or cancel online, any time. We remind you 5 days before every payment.

settings.title: Is it a stimulant?
settings.text: No caffeine and no stimulants. This won’t give you energy in an hour. It’s a daily routine you judge over 90 days.

settings.title: Is it safe with what I already take?
settings.text: Usually, yes. If you take medicine, check with your GP first, and don’t stop anything you take for a medical reason.
Welcome offer: a free £62 welcome kit with your first subscription, and 90 days to decide.
